convention: policy/MuJoCo actuator order (rear_left, rear_right, front_right, front_left x first, second, third), radians; the v6.27 URDF reads the same angles (identity joint map)
origin: mech/leg-cad-v6/anim_tricks/clips_new/<source>.json (analysis of 2026-10-19, out/tricks_raport.md): the stock tricks.py clips (shrek-dog 6b41e000) carried over by foot-path IK onto the v6.27 four-bar. bow, sit, shake: variant M3 (abduction scaled to the stock foot's lateral displacement). paw_wave: variant M2 (the stock abduction, 0.35 rad) with the slower weight-shift transitions. M3 paw_wave was the mechanical team's suggestion for the hip motor's rotor flange (16/13 N*m instead of 54/16 N*m on 3xM4), but in MuJoCo it tips the robot over at a 0.035 rad zeroing error (the plant's own lying-pose error; single-axis errors of 0.03 rad it survives), while M2 keeps the roll under 10 degrees for every error tried (2026-10-22). A fall onto the back was judged worse than the flange load; swap the source here to go back to M3.
start_pose_note: every clip starts and ends at the CAD 'stanie' stance; the runtime shifts each clip by (home - clip[0]) so it starts and ends at the robot's home stance (at most 0.03 rad per joint).
